crossings.proposal: Treat permitted knowledge state as part of a capability contract: fresh, bounded-window, lineage-enabled, or owner-local.
crossings.exaptation: AutoDisco's first-listen isolation becomes a general scheduler-visible property rather than a radio-specific trick.
evidence: AutoDisco mechanically separates fresh DJs from the lineage-aware Archivist.
GHoT already selects bodies by explicit capability and policy constraints.
reLATTE carries bounded crossings and receipts without transferring authority.
ROroomOM already admits guest capability surfaces without inherited grants.

boundary_checks.note: The posture constrains supplied context; it does not define personhood or identity.
Receiving lineage context cannot authorize local consequence.
RSC emits a candidate experiment; a human still selects execution.
